text:
mira: quick sync — planning to flip the feature flag emergency_disable_payment_processor ON for a 5% prod canary at 20:00 PST. need quick confirmations: who is authorized to flip, what the audit trail will show, rollback steps, and any pre-checks. tagging oncall and security for visibility @oncall-bot @audit-bot

sam: I can be oncall then. authorize flips to only SREs and Eng leads — let's limit to people listed in the runbook. use the redwood-toggle UI or CLI. post the exact CLI you plan to run.

mira: CLI i'll run (example):
```
redwood-toggle set emergency_disable_payment_processor --env prod --percent 5 --by mira --reason "canary to validate latency under new batching"
```

leo: make sure the toggle emits audit metadata: user, request_id, KMS_key_id, and an incident tag. security needs KMS key id surfaced in the log entry.

audit-bot: FYI toggles executed via the CLI or UI automatically emit entries to cloud logging under resource "toggle". verify with: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="toggle" AND jsonPayload.flag="emergency_disable_payment_processor"' --limit 5`

zara: quick ops note — rollback owner should be the oncall SRE if we see error spike. rollback action = set percent 0 and open a P0 if error rate > 0.5% or latency > baseline + 200ms.

cj: i'll create a grafana canary dashboard & alert (error-rate + p95) and have it ready by 19:00 PT. link will be posted here once done.

sam: confirmed owners: me, leo, and ana are the only ones authorized to flip this toggle for prod. i'll add this to the runbook and annotate the toggle ticket (#toggle-1774567890).

ana: small reminder: run the smoke tests after flip — `make smoke-test` against prod-canary path. if failures, rollback immediately and gather kv cache dump + controller logs.

mira: thanks. i'll update RDW-2412 with SOP, exact CLI, and contact list. @audit-bot can you add an incident tag `incident=toggle-1774567890` to the audit trail?

audit-bot: label added: incident=toggle-1774567890; linked to ticket RDW-2412; audit entry id a-12345.

zara: note for post-change: if we rollback we keep the flag disabled until a postmortem is complete. no silent re-enables.

sam: i'll be on standby 19:50-21:00 PT and will execute/rollback if needed. paging instructions are in the runbook.

mira: :thumbsup: all set — i'll post the final go/no-go 19:45 PT with a direct ping to the three authorized flippers.
